description: The largest loan the partner vaults fund now for at most maxCollateral of a token, or one exact loan (collateral and principal) priced as gage.cash prices it, in USDG or the lend asset named, with a prepare object for gage_prepare_borrow.

collateral.description: With principal: the exact pledge of one chosen loan, raw units

lendAsset.description: The asset the loan is paid in and repaid in: USDG when omitted, or a lend asset gage_capabilities lists (its token address)

maxCollateral.description: Most of the token to pledge, raw units: quotes the largest loan the vaults fund for it

principal.description: With collateral: the exact amount to borrow, raw units of the loan's asset; priced as the borrow card prices it

term.description: Loan term in seconds, one of the terms gage_capabilities lists
